steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each supplier is placed by its defect rate against the agreed limit and whether its lots were inspected.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 supplier is above its defect limit

findings.title: Defect rate above the agreed limit
findings.fix: Raise a corrective request with the supplier

findings.title: Lot received with no inspection
findings.fix: Inspect the lot and record it

findings.title: Corrective request past its due date

example:

pros: Checks a rate above the agreed limit, a corrective request past its due date, and a lot received with no inspection.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-supplier-quality-review skill on the records for this review.
